title: Ringing the bell for the parade and tiring from walking
summary: White rings the bell at his church and others, describes the echo, and how the second line went through the district; he can no longer keep up with parades.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
